hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase text-white

visual_enhancers.chrome_effect: Avoid cheap gradients. Use 1px borders of #C9CDD4 with 20% opacity. Use subtle inner shadows to simulate metallic reflections. Glassmorphism for floating elements (bg-[#0A1E4C]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.depth: Layered shadows, ambient glow behind emergency CTAs. Add subtle noise/grain texture overlay to background to kill digital flatness.

buttons.call_primary: Massive, highly tactile. bg-[#E30613] text-white font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(227,6,19,0.4)] hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors active:scale-95
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-600 flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors active:scale-95

layout_and_structure.mobile_first: CRITICAL. 90% of traffic is mobile. Components must be chunky, easily tappable. Font sizes must be readable on small screens. High density but generous padding (p-4 or p-6) within cards.
layout_and_structure.sticky_call_bar: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#E30613] text-white p-4 flex justify-center items-center font-black text-lg sm:text-xl md:hidden. Tapping it triggers `tel:+33185800061`. Add an animating phone icon.
layout_and_structure.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-8 right-4 z-40 bg-[#25D366] p-4 rounded-full shadow-2xl animate-bounce

hero.1440px: Grid 2 cols. Left: Massive H1, Trust badges, Double CTA. Right: Dramatic image of a tow truck. Background: Deep blue to black radial gradient with grain.
hero.390px: Stack. Image as dark background overlay. Text centered. Massive CTAs taking full width. Trust badges stacked or scrollable row.

layout_and_structure.trust_bar: A horizontal marquee or dense flex row of badges (24/7, 20 min, Tous assureurs, etc.). Use metallic/chrome icons.
layout_and_structure.services_grid: Bento-style grid. 7 services. Hover states lift the card and border glows electric blue (#1E4FD6).
layout_and_structure.map_section: Clickable zones for IDF. Visual representation of departments (75, 77, 78, etc.).
layout_and_structure.process: 3 steps. Vertical line connecting them on mobile, horizontal on desktop. Use chrome numbering.
layout_and_structure.callback_form: Simple, high contrast. 4 fields (Name, Phone, Location, Issue). Submit button is Electric Blue.
layout_and_structure.seo_pages: Templated local pages with dynamic H1s and schema.org markup.

motion.micro_animations: Buttons should have a satisfying 'press' effect (scale down slightly). Pulse animation on the emergency call button to draw the eye. Fade-up entrance for services grid.
motion.scrolling: Smooth scroll (lenis) recommended if feasible, otherwise standard with intersection observers.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #E30613 is readable with white text. Use text-shadow on hero text to separate from background image.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all icon-only buttons (like WhatsApp).

image_urls.description: Tow truck in harsh weather, implies rescue and reliability. Use for Hero background with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60).
Highway at night. Use for callback form background or map section background.

component_instructions.StickyMobileBar: Must be visible only on mobile screens (md:hidden). Red background, white text, fixed to bottom. Content: 'URGENCE - APPELER MAINTENANT'
component_instructions.FloatingWhatsApp: Visible on all screens. Fixed position right bottom. Make sure it doesn't overlap the sticky mobile bar on mobile.
component_instructions.TrustBar: Flex container with items separated by a chrome dot (•). Use text-sm or text-xs font-bold text-slate-300.
component_instructions.ServicesGrid: Map out the 7 services. Use icons for each. bg-[#0A1E4C]/50 border border-[#C9CDD4]/20 rounded-xl p-6.
component_instructions.Reviews: 6 realistic placeholders. Star rating in yellow/gold, text in white/slate. User name in bold.
component_instructions.FAQ: Use shadcn accordion. Dark theme styled.
component_instructions.Footer: Links to all 8 departments and 40 cities. Organized in grid.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid #0A1E4C.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute. E.g., `data-testid='call-button-hero'`.
